## `app.adapters.nightshift` — [app/adapters/nightshift.py](../app/adapters/nightshift.py)
**Purpose:** Nightshift adapter: the only path from VEDA to a model (lanes `fast` / `deep`, retries, JSON mode, trace).  
**Called by:** `app.agents.coordinator`, `app.agents.critic`, `app.main`, `scripts.critic_planted_errors`, `scripts.run_evals`
- `class NightshiftError` — A model call failed after retries, or the adapter is misconfigured.
- `class LLMResult` — What one chat() call returns.
- `def lane_model(lane)` — Model name sent to Nightshift for a lane (from env). Refuses unknown lanes and anything `auto`.
- `def expected_model(lane)` — The model that must answer a lane (env METERLESS_EXPECT_<LANE>, else EXPECTED_MODEL).
- `def lane_app(lane)` — `meterless-app` header for a lane. Nightshift pins routing mode per app, so each lane has its own app.
- `def is_ttfb_cut(error)` — True when Nightshift cut the call because no first byte came in time (~45 s).
- `def is_empty_response(error)` — True when the model answered with nothing (it spent its budget on hidden reasoning) - 24 Oct live: 4 of 13
- `def chat(lane, messages, agent, json_mode, thinking, tools, max_tokens, temperature, target_agent, budget_s, max_attempts, stream, purpose, fallback)` — Send one chat request through Nightshift on lane `fast` or `deep`. Returns LLMResult, raises NightshiftError.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI check of the AI lane: a fixed 'reply OK' request (never a user question) - prints the served model.

## `app.adapters.pg` — [app/adapters/pg.py](../app/adapters/pg.py)
**Purpose:** Postgres write connection to veda-pg: used only by ingest jobs (never agents - they read via Zetaris).

- `class PgError` — veda-pg is not configured, not reachable, or a database statement failed.
- `def check_config()` — Raise PgError if the writer password is missing (check BEFORE doing any expensive work).

- `def transaction()` — One transaction: commit on success, roll back on any error. Every database error surfaces as PgError.

## `app.adapters.zetaris` — [app/adapters/zetaris.py](../app/adapters/zetaris.py)
**Purpose:** Zetaris adapter: run_sql() is the only way VEDA reads data (live, record, or SAMPLE_MODE replay).  
**Called by:** `app.agents.critic`, `app.agents.data_agent`, `app.discover`, `app.engines.world_model.veda_ingest`, `app.gazetteer`, `app.loop`, `app.main`, `scripts.build_replay`, `scripts.make_synthetic_scenes`, `scripts.run_evals`, `scripts.seed_peaks`, `scripts.seed_places`, `scripts.seed_stations`, `scripts.setup_pg`, `scripts.setup_views`, `scripts.setup_wx`, `scripts.validate_rain_rule`
- `class ZetarisError` — A Zetaris call failed. `kind` tells the caller what to do:
- `class SqlResult` — What one run_sql() call returns.
- `def normalize_sql(sql)` — One statement: comments removed, whitespace collapsed outside quotes, trailing ; removed.
- `def read_only_problem(sql)` — None if `sql` is a pure read; otherwise a short reason. Checked outside quotes and comments.
- `def query_hash(sql)` — Stable 16-char id for a normalised SQL string (fixture file name).
- `def coerce(value)` — Zetaris returns text: turn numbers into int/float, keep everything else (IDs, dates) as text.
- `def run_sql(sql, agent, purpose, limit, budget_s)` — Run one read-only SQL statement through Zetaris (or replay it in SAMPLE_MODE). Returns SqlResult.
- `def ddl_problem(sql, setup)` — None if this DDL may run; otherwise a short reason.
- `def run_ddl(sql, agent, purpose, setup, budget_s)` — Run one allow-listed DDL statement (setup / self-healing). 'Already exists' counts as success.
- `def main(argv)` — CLI check: run one SELECT and print the rows.

## `scripts.setup_pg` — [scripts/setup_pg.py](../scripts/setup_pg.py)
**Purpose:** Set up VEDA's Postgres store (veda-pg) and register it in Zetaris. Idempotent: safe to re-run.  
**Called by:** —
- `def docker()` — Run a docker command with a timeout; returns CompletedProcess. Raises RuntimeError if Docker hangs.
- `def ensure_container()` — Create veda-pg if missing (bound to 127.0.0.1), re-create it if it is published on all interfaces
- `def ensure_network()` — Join veda-pg to the Zetaris network so Zetaris reaches it at veda-pg:5432.
- `def check_passwords()` — Role passwords must exist and be plain [A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,} (they are placed inside DDL options).
- `def connect(wait_s)` — Connect as the postgres superuser, waiting (bounded) for the server to accept connections.
- `def schema_statements()` — Statements from db/schema.sql: '--' comments removed and split on ';' - both only OUTSIDE quotes.
- `def apply_schema(conn)` — Roles (each with its own password), schema, constraints, writer grants. Returns (tables, constraints added).
- `def register_in_zetaris()` — CREATE DATASOURCE (once) + REGISTER DATASOURCE TABLES (every run, picks up new tables).
- `def smoke_check()` — COUNT(*) on every table through Zetaris. Returns {table: rows}.
- `def main()` — Run every setup step, tracing each one.
